Exporting with Deva Exim

How an order works, the terms we trade on, and answers to the questions buyers ask first.

How ordering works

From your first message to goods leaving the port.

  1. Send your enquiry

    Tell us the products, quantities, packaging and destination. The enquiry form or WhatsApp both work.

  2. Get a quotation

    We reply within one working day with prices, lead time and the Incoterm you asked for.

  3. Approve samples

    If you need samples, we courier 100 to 250 g of each product for testing.

  4. Confirm the order

    You confirm quantities and specifications; we issue a proforma invoice for payment.

  5. Production and checks

    Your lot is milled, checked and packed, and we send you the certificate of analysis.

  6. Dispatch

    Goods leave for the port with the shipping documents, and we share tracking details.

Trade terms

The usual terms are below. Everything can be discussed for regular orders.

Minimum order
25 kg per product. Several products can share one shipment.
Incoterms
EXW Pune, FOB Nhava Sheva, CFR or CIF to your port
Payment
Bank transfer (T/T) in advance, or L/C at sight for larger orders
Lead time
Usually 7 to 15 days from confirmation to dispatch
Sea freight
From JNPT (Nhava Sheva), about 140 km from Pune. LCL for smaller orders, FCL for full containers.
Air freight
From Mumbai air cargo (CSMIA) for urgent consignments. Samples go by international courier.

Questions buyers ask

What is the minimum order?

25 kg per product. You can combine several products in one shipment, which keeps freight costs down for trial orders.

Can I get samples before I order?

Yes. We send 100 to 250 g of each product by international courier so you can test it first. Tell us the products and your delivery address.

Which Incoterms do you work with?

EXW Pune, FOB Nhava Sheva, CFR and CIF to your port. Ask for the one that suits your forwarder.

What documents come with a shipment?

A commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of analysis, phytosanitary certificate and certificate of origin. Fumigation and other certificates can be arranged when your country requires them.

Are your products organic?

Our herbs are organically grown. If you need certified organic material (NPOP, USDA NOP or EU), ask us which products are available with certificates.

Can you pack under our brand?

Yes. We can pack in retail pouches or jars printed with your brand, from 100 g upwards.

How do I pay?

By bank transfer (T/T) in advance, or by L/C at sight for larger orders.

How long does an order take?

Usually 7 to 15 days from order confirmation to dispatch, depending on quantity and packaging. Sea transit time depends on your port.

Tell us what you need

Send the products, quantities and destination port. We reply within one working day with prices, lead time and freight options.
